checks.detail: Review candidate-bound runtime evidence against the PRD requirements for phase release_convergence.

Use ordinary keyboard and gamepad-equivalent input to verify camera-relative planar movement, collision sliding, visual facing, dash anticipation/invulnerability/recovery/cooldown, high-angle camera framing and clean pause/resume. Judge only behavior introduced by the active phase; reject hidden threats, contradictory velocity, stuck input or camera modes that drift toward FPS/TPS play.

Bind one stable event chain from cooldown and deterministic legal target selection through emitted attack, hit policy, damage, hurt, exactly-once death and drop. Require visible and audible anticipation, onset, impact and recovery without manual-fire drift, duplicate damage, freed targets, inert attacks or presentation disconnected from state.

Exercise active enemy roles from validated off-camera spawn through approach, separation, telegraph, attack, hurt, death, drop and pool return. Reject collision or out-of-bounds spawns, root sliding, static poses, first-frame damage, unreadable overlap, dead actors moving, permanent clumps, blocked escape lanes and stale pooled state.

Verify enemy reward, collection, experience threshold and overflow, one paused three-choice draft, debounced selection, authoritative build mutation and resumed play with an observable changed attack or utility. Reject duplicate drafts, held-confirm double choice, blank/inert cards, false values, lost overflow or gameplay clocks advancing under draft.

Require every introduced health, experience, level, wave/run, weapon, dash and boss field to match authoritative runtime state while leaving the arena readable. Judge native, fullscreen and supported UI scales; reject default fonts, debug labels, text piles, opaque blue/purple blocks, generic rounded cards, clipped controls and top-left-only pages.

From title through gameplay, pause, player failure and retry, verify single authoritative run transitions and a clean baseline after three restarts. Reject stale actors, timers, signals, pools, pause reasons, input ownership, attacks, effects or audio, and any state that requires restarting the application to recover.

Bind black-box ordinary play and white-box authoritative snapshots, events, transforms, animation/audio owners, logs and distributed frames to the exact candidate. Deterministic setup may reach legal branches, but normal runtime systems and input must cause the accepted outcome.

Pass: source and live representative rank-four combat retain three independent mechanisms—nearest-target focused Lantern bolts, threat-directed semicircular Gravespade sweeps with per-sweep hit policy, and persistent orbiting Wisps with per-target intervals. Runtime density evidence showed all three families active together, four Wisp handles and bounded hit ledgers. The inspected InputMap has no duplicate physical bindings, and ordinary W, Space and Escape probes reached movement, dash and pause through their owning contexts.

Fail for incomplete acceptance evidence: the five configured wave IDs, representative 32-enemy composition, live cap, Bellkeeper recovery/defeat and exactly-once victory commit were observed, but an uninterrupted ordinary route did not demonstrate ordered composition escalation, both boss phases, summons or lane pressure, recovery and director cessation after terminal state. The accelerated branch cannot prove ordinary reachability. The FPS occupancy patrol is inapplicable to this survivor-like surface and was not qualified from reciprocal body-before-shot sampling. coverage.baseline.fps_enemy_occupancy_occlusion.586166354018=insufficient_evidence;

Compare ordinary runtime views with the frozen Mournlight visual reference. Require one coherent bounded cemetery, grounded collision, keeper post, mausoleum and cracked bell landmarks, clear escape lanes, readable silhouettes, coherent scale/materials and no visible stand-ins.

Fail for incomplete acceptance evidence, while the camera repair itself passes: locomotion and held Cheer preserve the authored 41-bone owner, attached lantern and readable major-limb deformation with the self-occluding Mage_Hat isolated only at the presentation wrapper; the same silhouette remains readable in the dense shipped-camera frame. Cemetery composition directionally matches the reference through high-angle framing, cool moonlight, warm lantern hierarchy and clear routes, though with simpler rendering. Cheer produced one animation lease, one VFX onset and one victory authorization, but every active animation/VFX state was not exercised. The Effects capture was silent for both the target victory event and the same-bus footstep positive control, so semantic audible output remains a collector/driver qualification gap rather than a product-audio finding.

Navigate title, settings, upgrade, pause, death, victory and result pages across the full viewport with mouse, keyboard and gamepad focus. Verify persisted audio/window/UI-scale/effect settings, authored iconography and typography, truthful summaries and clean replay/title flow.

Fail: diagnostic profiles reached 3, 5, 10, 18 and representative 32-ordinary-enemy-plus-Bellkeeper workloads at 1920x1080 with all three weapons, pickups, HUD, VFX, lights and audio ownership; preserved caps included pool 40, neighbor 12, telegraphs 4 and role lights 8, and three completed cycles reported no live-count growth. Native qualification is unavailable because the renderer is llvmpipe, whose roughly 133 ms p50 and 140–148 ms p95 frame times cannot be attributed to the product. Independently, the reset receipts remain false across all three completed cycles: immediate and next-frame receipt contexts are boss while the live router is active. coverage.baseline.fps_runtime_stutter.6b972c8aebe3=insufficient_evidence;

Fail for incomplete acceptance evidence: ordinary Title-to-Play, movement, dash, pause/resume, Return to Title and Credits & Notices traversal passed, and the diagnostic victory Result was readable and exactly-once committed. The bounded ledger correctly refuses to manufacture ordinary rows and encodes ordered waves, a 420–600 second window, three actual build shapes, failure/retry, victory/replay and truthful statistics, but no uninterrupted ordinary seven-to-ten-minute victory, ordinary failure branch, three natural build runs or replay was completed. IPX disposition is mixed: first-minute goal comprehension, agency and shell hierarchy passed; full pacing, combat-audio authenticity and terminal continuity were not observed. Adjacent-continuity patrol passed on the readable, non-overlapping Credits & Notices surface with candidate provenance references.

required_criteria.requirement: Exercise every weapon and representative upgrade path. Require focused bolts, close sweep and orbiting area control to retain distinct targeting, cadence, geometry, hit policy, feedback and build consequences rather than renamed copies of one projectile.

Verify five data-driven wave states, composition escalation, elite pressure and the Bellkeeper's two phases, telegraphs, summons or lane pressure, recovery window, exactly-once defeat and victory. The director must honor live caps and stop after terminal state.

Inspect accepted component/source values and every active animation state, moonlight/lantern hierarchy, causal bounded VFX and semantic audio layer under real crowd density. Reject unrelated fallback clips, sliding/dead movement, overdark or clipped light, leaked loops, hum, unexpected speech, generic tones and effects that hide telegraphs.

Profile the representative final wave and boss at 1920x1080 with 25-40 ordinary enemies, all weapon families, pickups, animation, VFX, lights, UI and audio. Require stable frame-time distribution, bounded high-churn work and no growth across three complete retries.

Play the complete seven-to-ten-minute title-to-result run, including failure and victory branches, three viable build shapes, statistics, credits/provenance and replay. Reject placeholders, debug presentation, missing required content or unresolved release-relevant regressions.
